turns.text: How do I check my integration? Do I get access to the reference applications to test my flow?

must_contain: EMRSBX is a reference application you can use to test your integration
EMRSBX acts as a HIP and lets you generate records linked to ABHA addresses
access to the HIU reference app must be requested separately by email
notes: catalogue gap: the EMRSBX reference app and the HIU reference app request process are not documented
